name: c-code-block-1
title: Basic code block
label: Basic
description: Code block with header, filename, language and copy button.

guidance.bestFor: A static TypeScript snippet with line numbers, the resolved language label and a header copy button

whenNotToUse.when: A snippet that has to stay dark on a light page

name: c-code-block-2
title: Pinned copy button
label: Pinned Copy
description: Headerless block with a pinned copy button and dual-axis scrolling.

guidance.bestFor: A headerless snippet whose outlined copy button floats over the code, with both axes scrolled by a capped shadcn ScrollArea
agentNotes: `CodeBlockCopyButton` outside a header pins over the code and stays hidden until hover or focus; `alwaysVisible` keeps it shown

whenNotToUse.when: A snippet that needs its filename and language label above it

name: c-code-block-3
title: Streaming agent response
label: Streaming Agent
description: Agent writing code in real time with a caret and stick-to-bottom.

guidance.bestFor: A route handler typed out 3 characters per tick, with a Generating badge, a Replay button and a ScrollArea that follows the caret
agentNotes: `target` and the `setLength` timer fake the stream; pass your model's growing text as `code` and drive `streaming` from its status

whenNotToUse.when: A reply that mixes prose with fenced snippets in one message

name: c-code-block-4
title: AI chat with code fences
label: AI Chat
description: Streaming assistant message rendering markdown code fences.

guidance.bestFor: A 2 turn Frame transcript with avatars, where the streamed reply splits into prose paragraphs and a fenced snippet with copy
agentNotes: `reply` and the `setLength` timer fake the stream; run your message text through `markdownFences` and tie `streaming` to its status

whenNotToUse.when: A single generated file streaming in with line numbers and a caret

name: c-code-block-5
title: Diff with change summary
label: Diff Summary
description: A props-driven diff with added and removed lines and a change summary.

guidance.bestFor: Removed and added lines of a single file marked by number through the diff prop, under a header holding only filename and copy
agentNotes: The `diff` numbers are typed for this sample; recompute `added` and `removed` whenever `code` changes

whenNotToUse.when: A real git patch spanning several files with old and new numbers

name: c-code-block-6
title: Diff via shiki transformers
label: Transformer Diff
description: A diff expressed through a shiki transformer instead of props.

guidance.bestFor: A hand written shiki transformer that tags lines 2 and 3 as removed and added, hoisted to module scope so renders skip re-tokenizing
agentNotes: `notationDiff` tags lines 2 and 3 by number, so it goes stale when `code` changes; `@shikijs/transformers` reads diff markers in the source

whenNotToUse.when: Changed lines already known by number, with no transformer needed

name: c-code-block-7
title: Highlighted lines and words
label: Highlights
description: Line ranges and word matches highlighted together.

guidance.bestFor: A connection config with lines 2 to 4 tinted from a range string and 2 identifiers marked wherever they appear

whenNotToUse.when: Matches that follow a search field as the reader types

name: c-code-block-8
title: Focus walkthrough
label: Focus Walkthrough
description: Stepping through regions of a file with the rest dimmed.

guidance.bestFor: A 3 step tour of a checkout function, chosen with pressed buttons in the header, with a step counter and the other lines dimmed
agentNotes: Each `steps` entry pairs a button label with a `lines` range for this sample; rewrite both for your own file

whenNotToUse.when: Emphasis on a few lines while the rest stays at full strength

name: c-code-block-9
title: Terminal output
label: Terminal Output
description: Unhighlighted command output with a wrap toggle.

guidance.bestFor: Build output with highlighting turned off so shiki never loads, under a Terminal header with wrap and copy controls

whenNotToUse.when: Terminal output that still carries its ANSI color escapes

name: c-code-block-10
title: Long file with expand
label: Long File
description: Collapsed at a line budget with an expand control and a line offset.

guidance.bestFor: A generated file excerpt numbered from 120 and held near 8 rows by a ScrollArea that reads expanded state until Show more
agentNotes: `CollapsibleArea` caps the viewport with a fixed height class, so retune it whenever `maxLines` changes

whenNotToUse.when: Collapsing by indentation regions rather than at a line count

name: c-code-block-11
title: Line actions and diagnostics
label: Diagnostics & Actions
description: Error and warning lines with an action button on the active line.

guidance.bestFor: A function with an error line and a warning line, tallied in header badges, where a Fix line button appears on hover over either
agentNotes: The Fix line `Button` inside `CodeBlockLineActions` has no click handler; attach your fix action to it
The error and warning `Badge` counts are fixed text; derive them from `lineLevels`

whenNotToUse.when: A fix that rewrites the source in place and can be undone

name: c-code-block-12
title: Line selection
label: Line Selection
description: Selecting lines to ask an assistant about them.

guidance.bestFor: Controlled click and shift click line picking that feeds a selected count badge, an Ask about button and a Clear button
agentNotes: The Ask about `Button` has no click handler; send the `selected` line numbers to your assistant from it

whenNotToUse.when: Picked lines sent to a composer as file and line references

name: c-code-block-13
title: Search in file
label: Search In File
description: Live search marking every match, with a counter that reads the block through useCodeBlockConfig.

guidance.bestFor: A header search field that marks each case sensitive match, a badge counting matches in the source, and a floating copy button

whenNotToUse.when: A fixed set of words marked up front, with no search field

name: c-code-block-14
title: File tabs in a dense frame
label: File Tabs
description: A framed file switcher loading one grammar chunk per selected language.

guidance.bestFor: Snippets in tsx, Python, SQL and bash behind file tabs in a dense Frame header, each a ghost block with floating copy

whenNotToUse.when: Two versions of one file stacked for a before and after review

name: c-code-block-15
title: Pre-highlighted lines
label: Pre-Highlighted Lines
description: Lines built without shiki, the shape a server component passes down.

guidance.bestFor: Hand built tokens that color 4 Python keywords in light and dark, passed as lines so the client loads no highlighter
agentNotes: `lines` colors only 4 keywords with fixed hex values; pass `highlightCode` output from your server for real highlighting

name: c-code-block-16
title: Before and after
label: Before & After
description: Two blocks stacked in a frame for a refactor review.

guidance.bestFor: A loop refactored into a reduce, as 2 ghost blocks with Before and After headers in separate panels of one Frame

whenNotToUse.when: Changes shown inline as added and removed lines of one file

name: c-code-block-17
title: Soft wrap
label: Soft Wrap
description: Long single-line content with a wrap toggle.

guidance.bestFor: A single line CSP string that starts wrapped, with wrap state lifted to the page so a badge reads Wrapped or Scrolling

name: c-code-block-18
title: Unified patch review
label: Unified Patch
description: A git patch parsed into files with dual old/new gutters, counters and a download.

guidance.bestFor: A 2 file patch split into one block per file, each with plus and minus count badges and a download named after that file
agentNotes: `parseUnifiedDiff` runs once on the sample `patch` at module scope; call it on your own diff text, memoized when it changes

whenNotToUse.when: A single proposed change the user must accept or reject

name: c-code-block-19
title: Design-token theme
label: Design Token Theme
description: Syntax colors driven by CSS variables mapped to design tokens.

guidance.bestFor: A rose, violet, emerald, sky and amber palette set as class variables on the block, stepping to lighter shades in dark mode
agentNotes: Map your design tokens in `paletteClass`, which sets every variable the `css-variables` theme reads except the link token color

name: c-code-block-20
title: Always-dark block
label: Always Dark
description: A block that stays dark in both site themes, with window chrome and every line state.

guidance.bestFor: A dark scoped hero snippet behind 3 window dots, carrying a highlight, a word mark, a diff pair and all 3 diagnostic levels
agentNotes: Keep the `dark` class on the wrapper; it is what holds the block dark on a light page

whenNotToUse.when: A snippet that should follow the site theme in light and dark

name: c-code-block-21
title: Dark terminal
label: Dark Terminal
description: ANSI-style colored terminal output built from plain lines.

guidance.bestFor: A forced dark vitest log assembled span by span with light and dark hex colors, pass and fail marks and a summary row
agentNotes: Replace `rows`, the sample test log written as hand colored spans, with tokens built from your own log output

whenNotToUse.when: Raw process output that still holds its escape sequences

name: c-code-block-22
title: Patch review actions
label: Accept & Reject
description: Agent-proposed diff with accept and reject actions.

guidance.bestFor: An agent fix in a ghost block inside a Card, with Reject and Accept in the footer that flip to a status line and Undo
agentNotes: Accept and Reject only set local `decision` state; apply or discard the patch through your API in those handlers

whenNotToUse.when: A multi file git patch with old and new gutter numbers

name: c-code-block-23
title: Nested code folding
label: Code Folding
description: Fold regions detected from indentation, with nesting and fold-all controls.

guidance.bestFor: A sync function with 5 indentation regions, opening with its inner branch folded, plus Fold all and Unfold all in the header
agentNotes: `REGION_STARTS` lists this snippet's fold starts by hand, so Fold all goes stale once `code` changes

whenNotToUse.when: A long file cut at a fixed line count behind a Show more control

name: c-code-block-24
title: Fix with AI on the failing line
label: Fix With AI
description: A line action scoped to the diagnostic line that applies the patch.

guidance.bestFor: A reduce missing its initial value flagged on line 3, where a Fix with AI button on that line swaps in patched source with Undo
agentNotes: Fix with AI swaps `broken` for the canned `patched` string through `setFixed`; call your model there and apply its patch

name: c-code-block-25
title: Reference lines in chat
label: Reference Lines
description: A gutter button that turns lines or a selection into file:line reference badges in a chat composer.

guidance.bestFor: A gutter plus button that adds the hovered line or the whole selection to a Card composer, where pressing a chip highlights its line
agentNotes: The Ask AI `Button` has no click handler; send the `refs` line numbers with `PATH` to your model from it

whenNotToUse.when: A selection that feeds a single Ask button with no composer

name: c-code-block-26
title: Framed by an external ScrollArea
label: External Scroll
description: A changed-file list where one shadcn ScrollArea scrolls every block at once.

guidance.bestFor: A Card with 3 changed files that size to their content, scrolled together by one fixed height ScrollArea, each with count badges
agentNotes: The `added` and `removed` counts in `files` are invented beside each final source; take them from your diff

whenNotToUse.when: Changed files with real hunks and paired old and new line numbers

name: c-code-block-27
title: ANSI terminal output
label: ANSI Terminal
description: Agent stdout with SGR colour codes parsed by ansiToLines, retintable via --code-ansi-* variables.

guidance.bestFor: Vitest stdout with raw SGR escapes turned into colored tokens by ansiToLines, forced dark, with escape free text for copy
agentNotes: Pass your process output to `ansiToLines` in place of `stdout`; background colors and cursor moves are stripped, not drawn

whenNotToUse.when: Log lines already split into colored spans by your own parser
